description: When now > nextUpdate (stale) or nextUpdate is absent, the code returns OcspStatusUnknown. This conflates transient freshness failure with an authoritative revocation-status-unknown. The CRL checker has a distinct CrlExpired variant. Need to add OcspExpired error variant and use it here. File: pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs lines 186-188, 290-292.
title: ocsp: stale response returns OcspStatusUnknown instead of OcspExpired
